public.title: Insert Interval
public.description: intervals is sorted by start and contains disjoint closed intervals; each existing end is strictly less than the next start. Insert added and merge all overlaps, including touching endpoints. Return sorted disjoint intervals. There are 0 to 1000 existing intervals. Every pair has integer start no greater than end and endpoints between -1000000 and 1000000.
hints: Copy intervals entirely before the added one.
Grow the merged range until the next interval starts after it.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026, for a standard algorithmic problem. No third-party exercise text or solution code used.

explanation: Scan the before, overlapping and after portions in order. O(n) time and O(n) output space.
